log: Nothing touched the `TransportRegistry` when a unit was destroyed, so every way of losing a transport other than combat outside a city (`LostAtSea`, `Disband`, an unsupported unit, a home city captured or destroyed) left its cargo alive, `Stowed`, on a transport that no longer existed. Combat destroyed the cargo through the stack rule but left the manifests registered, and saved.
Two `Destroyed` rules, which every path goes through:
`unit/destroyed/lose-cargo`: unregisters the transport's manifests. On `Water` the cargo is destroyed, crediting the same player; on land (a city) it is left there, no longer `Stowed`.
`unit/destroyed/leave-transport`: a destroyed unit that is aboard something is unregistered from it.
`getRules` takes the `TransportRegistry` as a new trailing parameter.

`Stowed` never clears itself, so cargo destroyed with its transport, or by the stack rule before it, stayed `Stowed` with no manifest behind it. Both rules now go through one `leaveTransport`, which unregisters the manifest and clears `Stowed`.
